svg.desc: AQA A-level VSEPR shape examples and approximate bond angles through six electron regions.
svg.text: Molecular shapes with lone pairs through six electron regions
AQA A-level VSEPR shape examples and approximate bond angles through six electron regions.
Lone pairs occupy positions too; their stronger repulsion compresses the remaining bond angles.
AXₙEₘ: A = central atom; X = bonded atom; E = lone pair. Sketches are 2D projections; angles are idealised or approximate.
